subject: "Error: Unknown Parameter: mult" when attempting to plot data.

messages.author: 5d25f812c77c8271
messages.subject: "Error: Unknown Parameter: mult" when attempting to plot data.
parts: I have the Deducer package running in R 3.2.3 in Windows 7. However, any attempt to have Deducer plot any data of any sort returns the error: "Error: Unknown Parameter: mult". And no plot is generated. Is Deducer not fully compatible with R 3.2.3? Or is there some other likely diagnosis?
